properties.verseOrder: v1 p1 c1 b1 b2 b3

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
There He sits upon a throne
Sustainer of all things
The elders bow, the angels sing
This song forevermore

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
How can I comprehend
A beauty that has no end
You’ve beckoned us to come and see
Every nation testifies
Your majesty they can’t deny
Your Son has made a way for us to come

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
What do the elders see
That makes them all fall down
What do the angels see
That makes them cry, holy

verse.name: b2
verse.lines:
We have to know
We have to know
We have to know
What makes them cry, holy

verse.name: b3
verse.lines:
Open our eyes to see the wonder of Your majesty
To join in the song that all of heaven sings

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
There is only One (Jesus Christ)
There is only One (Jesus Christ)
There is only One (The Lamb upon the throne)
Found worthy (Forever)
